head: 2ff8d7636f3455e90463252de95f3e8873a70312
summary:
The only thing that changed since validate-1 (at 4cf607a) was O-011, and that fix is now in the tree. It holds when tested for real. `git diff 4cf607a..HEAD -- tests src eng` touches only tests/bugs/SL-064-MutantCases.ps1: C-007's cleanup check and its header comment. WindowMutants.ps1, MainWindow.xaml.cs and the acceptance test are byte-identical to what attempt 1 validated.

- **O-011 reproduction:** I re-ran the trigger that went red last time: C-007, with C-008 started 10 s later, both real publishes, 67 s in total.
  - C-007 exit 0: all 11 checks ok. It named exactly one copy (949698…), and that copy is gone.
  - C-008 exit 0: its copy 84d06a… overlapped C-007's run.
  - At 4cf607a the same run exited 1 with a false red.
- **Cleanup check can still fail:** I pulled Test-C007's cleanup statements out of the script's AST and ran them over the real C-007 output. They go red in three cases: the run's own copy re-created, a second copy named, and no copy named.
- **Full suite at current HEAD:** `-Mutant All` exit 0 in 334 s, all 9 killed. EndingObeysSkip was killed on topLevel.final 'False', with reading 1, bytes 393216 and files 6 set aside by MayFail. The source was unchanged, and no scratch copies or app processes were left.
- **Fast cases and rules:** C-001 to C-006 each exit 0. Fitness: 61 rules, all hold.

Criteria 1-8 are met by today's runs. Criterion 9 (a broken mutation is not counted as a kill) rests on attempt 1's two real broken mutations, a CS0103 compile error and a crash at the ending, plus today's C-005. Test-CaseMutant has not changed since then.

Not a loop: build-2 was sent back by a different finding (O-011) than anything before it, and it fixed that alone.

The bug report was only a title. I assumed the intent was a standing mutant in the harness with no app change, and the diff matches that.

My temp folder was removed, and the working tree has only the engine's own .taad changes.

checks.evidence: Only tests/bugs/SL-064-MutantCases.ps1 changed (10+/8-). WindowMutants.ps1, MainWindow.xaml.cs, WindowCases.ps1 and the acceptance test are unchanged since attempt 1.
61 rules checked against 99 parsed files. Every declared rule holds.

checks.what: Fast cases C-001..C-006 (binding, $CaseMutants wiring, anchor once inside ShowFinalTopLevel, compiled guard behaviour, kill classification, -Mutant All roster)
checks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/bugs/SL-064-MutantCases.ps1 -Case C-00N (N=1..6, each separately)
checks.evidence: All six exit 0 with 0 FAIL lines and 'PASSED: C-00N', 3 s in total.

checks.what: O-011 natural reproduction: C-007 with another harness user (C-008) creating a scratch copy in the shared folder 10 s into the run
checks.command: Start-Process pwsh ... SL-064-MutantCases.ps1 -Case C-007; Start-Sleep 10; Start-Process pwsh ... -Case C-008; wait for both
checks.evidence: C-007 exit 0 and C-008 exit 0, 67 s. C-007: every check ok, including 'the run named one scratch copy (949698499b6a4a5094651a26217c59be)' and 'the scratch copy was removed'. C-008's copy 84d06a9491e343b5946c9d92fc1f8b1f appears only in C-008's output. At 4cf607a this identical trigger gave C-007 exit 1.

checks.what: C-007 as a real end-to-end kill (criteria 5, 7)
checks.command: (same run as above; C-007 invokes WindowMutants.ps1 -Mutant EndingObeysSkip)
checks.evidence: ok: exits 0; PASSED: EndingObeysSkip; 'publishing the app' in the scratch copy; skip armed; topLevel.final FAIL line; actual 'False'; FAILED: L-002; Fail pattern matched and nothing else; real MainWindow.xaml.cs unchanged.

checks.what: C-008 unmutated control through the harness's own New-Scratch/Invoke-ScratchCase (criterion 8)
checks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/bugs/SL-064-MutantCases.ps1 -Case C-008 (run concurrently above)
checks.evidence: exit 0. Copy hash equals the real source. L-002 exit 0 and PASSED with no FAIL line. Skip armed and topLevel.final held. Remove-Scratch removed the copy, and the source is unchanged.

checks.what: The new C-007 cleanup check still goes red (independent red check)
checks.command: Took Test-C007's last 3 statements from the script's AST and dot-sourced them over the real C-007 output with a stub Check
checks.evidence: (1) Real output, copy gone: 2 ok. (2) The run's own GUID folder re-created under %TEMP%\fsa-window-mutants: FAIL 'the scratch copy was removed'. (3) An extra line naming C-008's GUID: FAIL 'the run named one scratch copy (949698..., 84d06a...)'. (4) No copy named: FAIL 'named one scratch copy ()'. The re-created folder was deleted with [IO.Directory]::Delete.

checks.what: Full mutant suite at current HEAD (criterion 6)
checks.evidence: exit 0 in 334 s. PASSED: StopDisabled, StopCollapsed, NoCrashHandler, NoExitRule, CancelThrows, HookFailsAfterActing, HookCompileError, HookLocked, EndingObeysSkip. EndingObeysSkip: L-002 exits 1 with reading '1', bytes '393216', files '6' and final 'False'. The harness matched the final line (got 1) and 'actual False'. Source hash unchanged, 0 scratch copies left, 0 FsAnalyser.App processes.
SDK 10.0.401 in the worktree's gitignored .dotnet (Q-003). Scratch parent empty before and after. No app processes. %TEMP%\sl064-validate2 removed. git status shows only the engine's .taad changes.
Not re-run by design. The engine ran it and recorded exit 0 (O-001 discharged). The file is unchanged since then.

checks.what: Real broken mutations (compile error, crash) through the real Test-CaseMutant (criterion 9)
checks.command: validate-1's temp driver (CS0103 Replace; throw-at-ending Replace)
checks.evidence: Not repeated this attempt. Validate-1 ran both at 4cf607a, and both were counted NOT killed. Test-CaseMutant and Set-Mutation in WindowMutants.ps1 have not changed since (git diff empty). Today's C-005 re-confirms the classification over synthetic shapes.
No src/ or C# file changed in this slice. The app was published inside the harness's scratch copies instead: 11 successful publishes this attempt (9 in -Mutant All, C-007, C-008).

criteria.criterion: 1. invoke the mutant harness by name, when -Mutant EndingObeysSkip is passed as the parameter value
criteria.how: C-001 exit 0: it binds through the real param block, and 'EndingObeysSkipX' is refused. C-007's real invocation of WindowMutants.ps1 -Mutant EndingObeysSkip exits 0 with PASSED: EndingObeysSkip.

criteria.criterion: 2. look up which case and file a mutant targets, when $CaseMutants is queried by the key 'EndingObeysSkip'
criteria.how: C-002 exit 0: Case L-002, File MainWindow.xaml.cs. The real runs (C-007, -Mutant All) ran L-002 against the mutated scratch copy.

criteria.criterion: 3. apply the mutant's Find/Replace to the real source, when the Find anchor's match count inside the current file is exactly one
criteria.how: C-003 exit 0: one match inside ShowFinalTopLevel, and duplicated or reformatted anchors are refused. The real runs applied it: Set-Mutation throws otherwise, and L-002 then behaved as the mutant.

criteria.criterion: 4. the mutated guard decides whether to show the final snapshot, when _skipNextRefresh is true when the scan ends
criteria.how: C-004 exit 0: with the skip armed, the real guard shows the final snapshot and the mutated one does not. In the real runs L-002 logged the skip armed, and topLevel.final was False under the mutant but held in the C-008 control.

criteria.criterion: 5. the harness decides whether a mutant is killed, when L-002's failure output contains the literal 'topLevel.final' failure line
criteria.how: -Mutant All: the harness matched exactly the topLevel.final FAIL line (got 1), with reading/bytes/files allowed by MayFail, and 'actual False'. C-005 exit 0: 8 shapes classified correctly.

criteria.criterion: 6. run the full mutant suite as normally scheduled, when -Mutant All is invoked
criteria.how: -Mutant All exit 0 in 334 s at HEAD 2ff8d76, with all 9 killed including EndingObeysSkip. C-006 exit 0: the roster matches the ValidateSet.

criteria.criterion: 7. kill the mutant end-to-end through the standing harness path, when the mutated app is actually built and L-002 actually run against it, not hand-patched
criteria.how: C-007 and -Mutant All both published the mutated app in a scratch copy ('publishing the app (eng/dotnet.ps1 publish)') and ran L-002, which FAILED on topLevel.final 'False'.

criteria.criterion: 8. confirm the kill is attributable to the mutation, not a pre-existing failure, with L-002 against the unmutated clean build through the harness's own sandbox
criteria.how: C-008 exit 0, run concurrently with C-007. New-Scratch's copy is identical to the real source. L-002 PASSED with the skip armed and topLevel.final held. The copy was removed.

criteria.criterion: 9. distinguish a genuine kill from a broken mutation, when the mutation causes a compile error or an app crash instead of a clean L-002 failure
criteria.how: From validate-1 at 4cf607a: a real CS0103 compile-error mutation and a real crash-at-ending mutation, both run through the real Test-CaseMutant, were both counted NOT killed. Test-CaseMutant and Set-Mutation are unchanged since (git diff empty for WindowMutants.ps1). Today's C-005 re-confirms the synthetic shapes. I did not repeat the real broken mutations this attempt.

obligations.evidence: Test-C007 (SL-064-MutantCases.ps1:363-370) now takes its own copy's GUID from its output, requires exactly one, and checks Test-Path on it. Get-Scratches is gone. The trigger that failed at 4cf607a (C-008 started 10 s into C-007) now gives C-007 exit 0, with its own copy 949698... named and removed while C-008's copy 84d06a... existed alongside. An independent red check on the real output fails when the own copy exists, when two copies are named, and when none is named.

Already discharged in validate-1 with real CS0103 and crash mutations, and the code it rests on is unchanged. Today's -Mutant All shows the kill counted only on the topLevel.final line plus 'actual False'.

not_reached: Kill reliability over many runs through the harness: this attempt saw 2 more real kills (C-007, -Mutant All), 4 across both attempts' standalone and suite runs. The 20/20 + 10/10 rate is from the risk spike's hand-patch.
A killed mutant run with the whole machine under load. The only overlap was two harness runs publishing at once.
Running the harness under Windows PowerShell 5.1. It was only parsed there, in earlier attempts. All runs used pwsh 7.
A machine with a machine-wide .NET 10 SDK. Every run used the worktree's repo-local .dotnet 10.0.401 (Q-003).
Real broken mutations (compile error, crash) were not re-run this attempt. They are carried from validate-1 against unchanged harness code.
A real mutation that exits 0 without writing a report, without crashing. Only C-005's synthetic shapes cover it.
Future drift: the -Mutant All roster is hard-coded, so a later mutant added to the ValidateSet but not to All is caught only if someone re-runs C-006.
The bug report was only a title. Its intent (a standing mutant in WindowMutants.ps1, no app change) was assumed from the repro test and the design. Nobody confirmed it.
